text:
mia (pm): Quick sync — we need a concrete compatibility-shim runway + comms for customers who pin older model versions. Goal: minimize user breakage but reclaim capacity for new models.
rajan (eng): Putting together an ops-friendly shim: lightweight adapter that maps old tokenizer ids and falls back to smaller KV cache for legacy pins. Low-risk but adds ~5-8ms per token.
sophia (research): For onboarding/baseline, we should require: perf delta <= 3% quality (ROUGE/BLEU/LL) on our core eval suite and latency p95 within +20% of pinned baseline. If outside, fail canary.
lena (cs): Customers will ask for opt-out windows. Propose: 60-day grace period + one extra month of paid pin-extension. We should prepare a canned email + support playbook.
alec (prod-marketing): We need precise launch criteria to coordinate comms. Can we define the canary gates and rollback conditions today?
rajan (eng): Draft canary gate (run nightly on subset of traffic):
```
- success_rate >= 99.5% (no OOMs / failures)
- latency_p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.2
- quality_delta <= 3% on prod prompt sample
- CPU/GPU mem growth <= 10%
```
If any gate fails for 3 consecutive runs -> auto-rollback to pinned instance.
mia (pm): Nice. Add an opt-in canary flag customers can set to test the shim before full migrate. Also we need tagging in Console: "shim-tested", "shim-failed", "pin-exempt".
ops-bot: Reminder: I'll create a scheduled canary job that posts results to #eng-runtime every morning at 06:00 UTC.
lena (cs): For the playbook: include templates: "customer-facing migration invite", "extended-pin invoice", and SLA impact note. I'll draft and share before EOD Thu.
sophia (research): One more ask — add a small eval harness that runs win/loss prompt-level diffs for critical customers (top 10 by spend). If regressions > 1% on targeted prompts, block rollout for that customer.
rajan (eng): Implementation plan: 1) build shim + unit tests (2w), 2) internal canary (1w), 3) opt-in beta with selected customers (2w), 4) staged migration with monitoring/rollback (rolling over 4 weeks).
mia (pm): Timeline looks good. I'll convert this into an initiative PR with milestones and acceptance criteria. Action items: @rajan finalize gate checks, @lena draft comms, @sophia add eval harness, @alec prep customer-facing FAQ. :thumbsup:
alec (prod-marketing): Will do. Suggest adding a short "what changes for developers" note for the Console docs (code snippet showing `model_pin: true` -> new opt-in flag `compat_shim: true`).
mia (pm): Cool — next sync Friday 09:30 PT to review canary results. Thanks all.
